details: Every finite binary concept class satisfies $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: The cited paper proves $\mathrm{SCdim}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal H)-1$ and $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H)=\mathrm{SCdim}(\mathcal H)+1$. Combining the two displayed equalities yields the claim.
